sentences.text: Det var en kald dag, og det regnet mye. Nils gikk hjem fra skolen.
sentences.english: It was a cold day, and it rained a lot. Nils walked home from school.

sentences.text: På veien fant han en liten hund. Hunden satt under en bil.
sentences.english: On the way he found a small dog. The dog sat under a car.

sentences.text: Den var våt og redd, og den var kald.
sentences.english: It was wet and afraid, and it was cold.

sentences.text: Nils var også våt, men han ville hjelpe hunden.
sentences.english: Nils was wet too, but he wanted to help the dog.

sentences.text: Hei, lille venn! Hvor er eieren din?
sentences.english: Hi, little friend! Where is your owner?
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Hunden kom til Nils. Han tok den med seg.
sentences.english: The dog came to Nils. He took it with him.

sentences.text: Nils gikk til Marta. Han hadde hunden i jakka.
sentences.english: Nils went to Marta. He had the dog in his jacket.

sentences.text: Hva har du, Nils?
sentences.english: What have you got, Nils?
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Jeg fant en hund! Den er våt og kald. Vi må finne eieren.
sentences.english: I found a dog! It is wet and cold. We must find the owner.
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Ja, vi må finne ham. Men først må vi hjelpe den.
sentences.english: Yes, we must find him. But first we must help it.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Marta tok brød og melk. Hunden spiste og drakk. Så sov den.
sentences.english: Marta took bread and milk. The dog ate and drank. Then it slept.

sentences.text: Du reddet hunden, Nils. Du er snill.
sentences.english: You rescued the dog, Nils. You are kind.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Neste dag lette Nils og Sam i byen. De spurte folk: «Har du mistet en hund?»
sentences.english: The next day Nils and Sam looked in town. They asked people: "Have you lost a dog?"

sentences.text: Mange sa nei. Til slutt kom de til et lite hus. Fru Berg bodde i huset.
sentences.english: Many said no. At last they came to a small house. Mrs Berg lived in the house.

sentences.text: Fru Berg! Har du mistet en hund?
sentences.english: Mrs Berg! Have you lost a dog?
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Ja! Hunden min er borte! Hvor er den?
sentences.english: Yes! My dog is gone! Where is it?
sentences.speaker: berg

sentences.text: Nils hadde hunden med seg. Eieren var fru Berg!
sentences.english: Nils had the dog with him. The owner was Mrs Berg!

sentences.text: Fru Berg ble veldig glad. Hun sa: «Takk, Nils! Takk, Sam! Dere har reddet hunden min.»
sentences.english: Mrs Berg became very glad. She said: "Thank you, Nils! Thank you, Sam! You have rescued my dog."

sentences.text: Hva heter den?
sentences.english: What is its name?
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Den heter Bjørn. Bjørn er en bra hund. Jeg er glad i den, og jeg er glad i dere.
sentences.english: Its name is Bjørn. Bjørn is a good dog. I am fond of it, and I am fond of you.
sentences.speaker: berg

sentences.text: Sam husket fru Berg fra første dagen i Bergen. Hun var fortsatt like snill.
sentences.english: Sam remembered Mrs Berg from the first day in Bergen. She was still just as kind.

sentences.text: Etterpå bakte Sam selv: mel, salt, gjær og deig. Han satte brødet i ovnen, og det ble ferdig og lukter godt. Det smakte riktig.
sentences.english: Afterwards Sam baked himself: flour, salt, yeast and dough. He put the bread in the oven, and it became ready and smells good. It tasted right.

sentences.text: Anna fikk et tilbud fra et sykehus, og valget var vanskelig. Fiskerne drar ut og fanger fisk. Mange kommer til gudstjeneste på søndag. Strøm kommer fra elver og fjell.
sentences.english: Anna got an offer from a hospital, and the choice was difficult. The fishermen go out and catch fish. Many come to the service on Sunday. Electricity comes from rivers and mountains.
